title: feat(app-shell): the marketplace install dialog and the local-install confirm show which existing objects a package changes, platform objects flagged and acknowledged
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoBAnEyxhTeomXorDRe5XRUC)_

Fixes #31542

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：应用市场的托管安装对话框和本地安装确认框，现在会列出软件包要修改的已有对象（字段、显示补丁、校验规则、索引、标签），平台对象（`sys_*`）排在最前并醒目标出；只要涉及平台对象，必须勾选确认才能安装。
- 为什么改：之前管理员同意安装时完全看不到软件包会改哪些已有对象，而扩展 `sys_user`、`sys_session` 这类平台对象可能影响登录和用户资料。
- 风险与回滚：只改安装前的展示和一个确认勾选，安装请求本身不变；目录不给出该信息时退回读取已读的清单，读不到就明说"无法读取"。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`（`objectExtensions` 的取值顺序和安装按钮的禁用条件）、`ObjectExtensionDisclosure.tsx`、`installPreview.ts` 的 `objectExtensionsIn`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePackagePage.installPreview-30325.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePackagePage.installMode-12288.test.tsx`，预期全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：席位（domain:ui#4）审过，并已写声明面的契约复审记录（6843621467，PASS）。新增文案键都在按需加载的 marketplace 命名空间里，11 种语言齐全，没有改动或删除已有键；只改安装前的展示和一个确认勾选，不碰服务端和 cloud 仓库。目录给 `null` 时明说"无法读取"而不是"没有修改"。已知取舍：清单还在读取或读不到时不拦安装，这与卡上"null 只需明说"的约定一致。CI 全绿后按队列落地。

## What changes

**The catalog field (`marketplaceApi.ts`).** `MarketplacePackageVersion.object_extensions` is typed as the card states it (`readonly MarketplaceObjectExtension[] | null`, absent on a catalog that does not serve it). `MarketplaceObjectExtension` carries `object`, `platform`, `fields`, `field_patches`, `validations`, `indexes` and `relabels`.

**One disclosure component (`ObjectExtensionDisclosure.tsx`, new, beside `PluginDisclosure`).** It draws what each value says:

- a list: each target object with the fields it adds or replaces, the fields whose display it patches, the rules it adds or replaces, how many indexes it adds, and whether it overrides the label. A platform target gets a "Platform object" badge, an amber edge and a warning line. The component draws the order it is given; the producer serves platform targets first.
- `[]`: nothing is drawn.
- `null`: an amber note that what the package changes could not be read. It is never drawn as "changes nothing".
- `undefined`: a muted "reading" line.

When any target is a platform object and the surface passes `onAcknowledgedChange`, the component draws an acknowledgment checkbox. `needsPlatformAcknowledgment()` is the one rule both surfaces use to hold Install.

**Both surfaces (`MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`).**

- The hosted install dialog draws the disclosure for every package, not only for code plugins. Its Install is disabled while a platform target is unacknowledged.
- The local-install confirm (`install-preview-dialog`) draws it below the counts. Its Install (`install-preview-confirm`) is disabled under the same rule.
- The acknowledgment holds for one opening. An effect clears it once both surfaces are closed, because the dialog's own Close button calls `setInstallOpen(false)` and bypasses `onOpenChange`.
- Where the list comes from, in order: the catalog's `object_extensions` on `latest_version` (the version both doors install). On a catalog without the key, it comes from the manifest the page already reads once before install (`getServedPackageBody`, the read the card's step 3 names). That read exists and returns `data.manifest` of `GET /packages/:id/versions/latest/manifest`. If this runtime has no manifest read (no install-local route and no cloud base) or the manifest cannot be read, the value is `null`.

**The manifest reading (`installPreview.ts`).** `InstallPreview` gains `objectExtensions`. It is read from every package body the preview already walks (top level with a nested `manifest:` lifted, and each `packages[]` body), and from each body's `metadata.objectExtensions`. That is the set of surfaces the card names. There is one entry per target object, platform targets first. `fields` and `fieldPatches` contribute their keys. A validation contributes its `name`, or `(unnamed)` when it has none. `indexes` contributes a count. `label`, `pluralLabel` and `description` set `relabels`.

**i18n.** The new `marketplace.objectExtensions.*` keys go in the lazy `marketplace` namespace (`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/marketplace/*`) in all ten hand-written locales. `zh-Hant` is generated by `gen:zh-hant`. The claim's file surface first named `src/locales/*`; the seat amended it (6839906996) after I measured that every existing `marketplace.install.preview.*` and `marketplace.disclosure.*` key lives in the namespace. The eager English pack and its gz ceiling are untouched. The index count is an i18next count family in every pack (`count-families-11445` requires one), with each language's CLDR slots.

**Changeset:** `.changeset/31542-install-object-extensions.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch and `@object-ui/i18n` patch, both declaration lines. Clause-② is `yes (widening)` because `./namespaces/marketplace` is an exported subpath of `@object-ui/i18n`, so its new keys are published.

## Tests

Final head `11d28d49`. The pins are top-level `describe`s in the existing shared harness files.

- `__tests__/installPreview-30325.test.ts`: a new `describe` pins the manifest reading. A business target and a `sys_user` target come back platform first, with each field, patch, named and unnamed rule, index count and relabel. `metadata` and `packages[]` bodies are read and merged per object. A body that extends nothing reads `[]`, never `null`. The three existing `toEqual` cases gain `objectExtensions: []`.
- `__tests__/MarketplacePackagePage.installPreview-30325.test.tsx` (local confirm), five cases:
  - business plus platform: both listed with the platform one first and flagged. Install is disabled, a click posts nothing, and after the acknowledgment one install posts.
  - `[]`: no section, and Install is enabled.
  - `null`: "could not read", and Install is enabled.
  - CONTROL: a catalog without the key reads the served manifest, and the same rule holds Install.
  - CONTROL: a catalog without the key plus an unreadable manifest gives "could not read".
- `__tests__/MarketplacePackagePage.installMode-12288.test.tsx` (hosted dialog, metadata package with no `contains_code`), six cases: business plus platform; closing the dialog drops the acknowledgment; business only (not held); `[]`; `null`; CONTROL catalog without the key. The harness `Wire` gains `catalogVersion`, merged into `latest_version`.
- Runs (all under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`):
  - the three files: 72/72.
  - `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/ packages/i18n/` after the merge of `origin/main` and a fresh `@objectstack/spec` build: Test Files 160/160, Tests 2465 passed, 13 skipped.
  - `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` `type-check` (src and test programs) after a full build of `@object-ui/app-shell^...`: exit 0.
  - eslint `--no-inline-config` over the changed ui files: 0 errors. The warnings are existing `no-explicit-any` hits in the touched files.

<details><summary>Ablation: drop the platform-acknowledgment requirement</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `const extensionsUnacknowledged = needsPlatformAcknowledgment(objectExtensions) && !extensionsAcknowledged;` with `const extensionsUnacknowledged = false; /* ABLATION-31542 */` in `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`. It reported anchor 1 → 0, marker 0 → 1, blob `adcf60f3358e` → `56992a90d3e9`. The two page harness files then went red: Tests 5 failed / 58 passed. The red pins were both "Install waits for the acknowledgment" cases, both CONTROL manifest cases, and "closing the dialog drops the acknowledgment". The tool restored the file: blob after restore `adcf60f3358e` equals the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The test subject is imported from source (`../MarketplacePackagePage`), so no dist was involved.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Reading state does not hold Install.** While the manifest read is in flight on a catalog without the key, the dialog shows "reading" and Install is not held. Only a known platform target holds it, and `null` does not either. The card asks for the acknowledgment when a target is a platform object. Holding on "unknown" would block every install on a runtime with no manifest read.
- **Merging per object in the fallback is my reading.** I could not read cloud's `package-object-extensions.ts` from this container. If the producer lists two extensions of one object separately, the catalog path draws them as served. Only the fallback merges.
- **The code-consent checkbox keeps a pre-existing leak.** The dialog's Close button bypasses `onOpenChange`, so the existing code acknowledgment (`acknowledged`) and `installResult` survive a Close and reopen. I fixed it for the new acknowledgment only. The existing one is reported in the dev report, not changed here.
- **Docs: deviation.** `ui/AGENTS.md` #2 (docs-driven) is not done in this PR: the claim's file surface does not include `content/docs/frontend/` or a README.
- **Assignees: deviation.** The dispatch order asked for `pr_create` without assignees, so the PR has none. `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` rule 2 has the create carry the claim's `Account:`. The conflict is reported to the seat.
